# Survival rate of a fresh seeker-sprouts start across seeds

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | build |
| Result | refuted |
| Created | L1.I10 |
| Updated | L2.I7 |

## Hypothesis

Seeker-sprouts played by the unchanged playbook survives to 5:00 on Nightmare 1 on more than half of fresh seeds, which would justify fixing it as the playbook's starting weapon.

## Method

5 fresh seeds from 0:00, 300 s, playbook unchanged, start seeker-sprouts. Record survival, chests, evolution time and kills.

## Findings

The unchanged seeker-sprouts playbook lived 5:00 in 1 of 5 fresh loop-2 seeds (35; died 3:23, 3:08, 0:52 and 3:16 on 31-34) and in 1 of 1 on seed 23 in loop 1. It does not survive on more than half of fresh seeds, but it is still the only start that reaches 5:00. The knobs arm is the playbook now (see opening-forecast-knobs).
